artwork.chineseIntroduction: 《睡莲》，克劳德·莫奈，1916至1919年，布面油画。这幅晚期作品描绘了莫奈在吉维尼家中营造的水上花园。画面没有明显的地平线，睡莲、倒影与水面融为一体。请放慢脚步，观察色彩与笔触，感受水面和倒影之间若隐若现的边界。
artwork.description: A pond becomes a world of its own. In this late Water Lilies painting, Monet returns to the water garden he created at his home in Giverny.
artwork.detail: Look at how floating leaves, reflections and open water share the same surface. With no horizon to anchor the scene, your eye can wander through the colour and loose brushwork. Take a moment to notice where the water ends and its reflection begins.
artwork.source: The Metropolitan Museum of Art · Collection record 437137
artwork.title: Water Lilies

artwork.description: A pond becomes a world of its own. In this late Water Lilies painting, Monet returns to the water garden he created at his home in Giverny.
artwork.detail: Look at how floating leaves, reflections and open water share the same surface. With no horizon to anchor the scene, your eye can wander through the colour and loose brushwork. Take a moment to notice where the water ends and its reflection begins.
artwork.source: The Metropolitan Museum of Art · Collection record 437137

artwork.description: A pond becomes a world of its own. In this late Water Lilies painting, Monet returns to the water garden he created at his home in Giverny.
artwork.detail: Look at how floating leaves, reflections and open water share the same surface. With no horizon to anchor the scene, your eye can wander through the colour and loose brushwork. Take a moment to notice where the water ends and its reflection begins.
artwork.source: The Metropolitan Museum of Art · Collection record 437137
